title: Patching LG G Watch W100 care pack, now stuck on boot
symptom: After installing the care pack for LG G Watch W100 (build M1D65S), patching throws an error and the watch is stuck on the LG boot screen forever. Manual patching with xdelta3 gives a checksum error, and even with no-checksum option the result is the same.
evidence_quote: I applied the patch manually in the adb shell and get an error when patching with xdelta3. The checksum is incorrect and patching stops. By adding the no-checksum-option I'm able to apply the patch but the result is the same. The watch hangs at the boot image.
